_note_rules: 🔴 critical_price is the ONLY armed rule, and that is deliberate (Juan, 2026-09-06). _note_critical_price: ⭐ Here critical_price does only ONE of its two jobs, and that is what makes R$400 coherent so far under the market. Job (1), the alert: it fires on ENTERING the band and again on every downward move inside it, comparing against the LAST RUN's minimum — not an all-time record — so it cannot ratchet shut and it reports a market falling through R$400 the whole way down. Job (2), the anomaly floor that keeps a mispriced row out of a baseline, has nothing to protect here because no baseline rule is armed. ⛔ If lowest_ever is ever switched back on, revisit this number immediately: R$400 sits ~3x under the observed floor (R$1.197,90 on 2026-09-06), so as a floor it is uselessly loose and a mispriced R$500,00 row would take the lowest_ever record permanently — the 04/09 R$66,00 failure, repeated.
